protocols.title: Thymogen (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Individual-page statements from a secondary source; not independently verified medical guidance. Registered-product schedule reported by page: about 100 mcg IM once daily for a short 3–10 day course; intranasal use is also described. 10 mg + 2 mL bacteriostatic water gives 5 mg/mL, but source warns this research vial is ~100 reference doses. Russian-registered, not FDA-approved; do not confuse alpha-L-Glu-Trp with golotimod/SCV-07.

schedule.description: Source also describes intranasal administration; distinguish alpha-L-Glu-Trp from golotimod/SCV-07.

regimen.notes: Registered-product schedule reported by the page; not FDA-approved and not a recommendation for research-vial use.
